def solve(g):

    sep_rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1]

    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    def special(r,c,v): pass
    A={}
    for r in range(h):

    for v,cells in A.items():
        cs=[c for r,c in cells]; rs=[r for r,c in cells]
        for k1,(r1,c1) in enumerate(cells):

                if c1==c2:  # vertical pair
